task: Four-GPU L40S scaling at fixed effective batch16
user_selected_recipe: Earlier rank64 standard masked loss; no city uniqueness loss

stress.sample: 16 longest examples from the same 512-row training-only sample

measurement: CUDA synchronized complete forward/loss/backward/clip/AdamW/scheduler update; max elapsed across ranks; excludes loading, metric collectives and JSON writes
timing_order: One-GPU and two-GPU controls before four-GPU screening; four-GPU top two confirmed twice in reverse order; then two-GPU and one-GPU controls; selected four-GPU upper-tail check.

ddp.local_loss_normalization: mean over each equal-sized local batch; DDP averages gradients once

screen_selection_notes: Four GPUs hold four examples per rank per update; valid microbatches are 1, 2 and 4.
Same dtype, model, rank64/alpha64, objective, 512-example sample, optimizer, schedule and global batch as the earlier 1v2 run.
mb4/none rechecked after its prior one- and two-GPU memory failures.
mb4/quarter omitted: earlier matched L40S results had less than 1 GiB headroom; half and full checkpointing cover larger-batch tradeoffs.
Effective batches larger than16 are outside this matched scaling comparison.
limitations: Different GPU counts/microbatches change RNG draws and padding; no claim of bitwise equivalent training between layouts.
Short profile checks speed and execution, not convergence or solution quality.
No full fine-tuning or checkpoint resume is launched.

baseline_controls.two_gpu_pair: first two allocated GPUs in both repeats
baseline_controls.single_gpu: first allocated GPU before sweep; second allocated GPU after sweep

topology_note: Availability check showed three selected GPUs sharing a PCIe switch and the fourth across CPU sockets; capture actual allocation topology.
